_note: just the closed gate vocabulary tools/precedent_gate.py needs -- the
source file's own `practices` key documents the routing reason for every
one of BestPractice's OWN practices, which has no meaning here. The gate
vocabulary itself (moments a practice can fire at, independent of which
catalogue it belongs to) is the same everywhere Precedent's loader runs.
The gate vocabulary is closed: tools/verify_harness.py refuses an unknown gate name, and refuses a gate with no practices. Each gate names a moment with a real invocation point in this repo.
gates.review: reviewing work, or a review finding a defect
gates.reply: ending a turn and writing the reply — the stop hook
